interpretationDecisions.decision: Numeric +F values report remaining advantage. They are not invented delay durations. All intentional cr.LK/cr.LP/st.LP framekills include (whiff) in compact and copied notation. Actual delayed throws use unquantified visible timing cues.

Fine input-history probes91.0,275.8–279.8 and388.0–392.0 resolve crouching medium punch, not crouching heavy. Corner branches perform heavy Scythe, light Rhino and light Wheel; midscreen branch performs heavy Scythe and medium Rhino. No generic any ender was guessed.

Setup clips retain prerequisite combos, but performed sequence and cost begin after the prerequisite. Heavy-Rhino prerequisite spends one raw Rush, with any additional follow-up raw Rush separately counted.
214LP plus6LP is the performed Moon-Glider punch follow-up. Lynx Song236LP plus6HP extends via Lynx Whirl; the roll follow-up6LK is separate. These are distinct sequences, not an install or charge.

Actual Bison OD Psycho Crusher and Kimberly run-attack Perfect Parries are retained with damage scaling. Early Scythe cancellation after the two observed hits into6LP/6MK is explicit. One Bison branch spends DI; the jab branches spend no attacking Drive. Defensive parry remains part of the exchange.

The raw-Rush/crouch-guard take makes Ryu’s OD Shoryuken miss above Elena; it is not a recorded block. The separate heavy-target carry punish does block Ryu’s OD Shoryuken. Actual blocked reversal claims otherwise refer to Ryu Drive Reversal, Lily Level1 and Bison Drive Reversal. No on-reaction or all-reversal guarantee. KEI.B safe-jump opponent DP strength is unresolved, so that extraction is excluded.

The two airborne interceptions are Air-to-air responses, not tagged Anti-air. The heavy-target/Rush carry begins Midscreen and visibly advances through the stage; Corner is not a starting-situation tag.

remainingGaps: Dedicated grounded anti-air demonstrations remain absent from the appended extraction. Air-to-air responses are separately labeled.
